caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, which appears to be a long, loose-fitting coat or dress in a grayscale color scheme. The garment features detailed embroidered or decorative edging along the central opening, sleeve cuffs, yoke, and hem. The decoration consists of a continuous, ornate, and symmetrical floral or vine-like pattern. There is also a fringe trim at the hem, sleeve edges, and across the upper back and chest, just below the decorative yoke and shoulders. The garment has wide, long sleeves and a high, round neckline, with the body flaring outwards into an A-line shape. The drawing is centered on a pale, blank background, and the garment is depicted without a wearer, creating an empty collar and sleeves. The artwork uses delicate lines and shading to convey the texture and details of the fabric and ornamentation.
title: Coat
